title: Return physical block results through the actual normalized Gaussian Core
body:
The existing physical Gaussian block pipeline stopped after recovering the two scalar boundary solutions. This package carries those streams through unchanged `Core.second_cell`, `normalize_cell`, and the final complex disk guard, preserving source order, cropping, protected returns and cleanup.

The source-relative proof derives explicit magnitude and perturbation recurrences for the actual seven Interior stages (five diagonals, two completed-coordinate rounded convolutions). It gives sufficient intermediate width and final disk conditions without an unspecified inverse constant or an incorrect equality with scalar BandedSolve. The reference remains the supplied rounded block-factor function; actual global-Gaussian coefficient admission and first-pass/block error remain separate.

The nonzero five-row supplied-factor calibration compares two complete schedules. Retaining selections costs 29,995,126 tape operations and 22,910 retained owner cells; regathering costs 30,220,120 and 22,478. Retain therefore saves 224,994 operations at 432 additional retained cells. Both return the exact same cropped complex stream, execute four actual interior calls, and preserve borrowed source/page/factor bytes and heads. Common physical factor preparation costs 946,116 operations separately. The deliberately changed 1/64 boundary diagonal is calibration, not a global-Gaussian matrix claim.

Validation: normal complete gate PASS (8.131s), final committed Git-free optimized typed receipt PASS (13.693s), metadata/source pins, 33-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, explicit-input export/check, four actual CLI source-corruption controls and two bool/int receipt controls PASS. Independent agent review checked source correspondence, 200 signed-rational stage pairs and final margins; its receipt typing finding was repaired. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

No net speedup over old scalar Core, recursive paid-profile saving, new kappa or selected-frontier change. No Lean, Docker, historical full suite or selected-frontier replay. Combined registered scientific replay was not duplicated after the individual normal and optimized commands.
